parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports all other components such as doors, shelves, and drawers.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire cabinet together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of the structure and contents.
parts.Functional_description: It stabilizes the cabinet and distributes weight evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the left side of the cabinet opening.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened and conceals contents when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the right side of the cabinet opening.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right compartment of the cabinet and conceals stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding storage component located at the top of the cabinet, made of plywood with a front handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides easy access to smaller items and utensils stored inside.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood, dividing the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and helps organize the cabinet interior.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on design.
